Incident.description: Active live-site incidents. AlertPayload is the Azure Monitor envelope; EngineerNote is the on-call's first observation; Tags is regex-extracted error metadata; ProposedMitigation is filled in by usp_GenerateMitigation.

IncidentArchive.description: Resolved historical incidents with RootCause and Mitigation. The corpus that hybrid search retrieves from.

Runbook.description: Service runbooks (e.g. Payroll.7) keyed by RunbookId. Retrieved alongside prior incidents during hybrid search.

HybridSearch.description: Hybrid (JSON + vector) RAG search over IncidentArchive and Runbook. Pass TenantId, the natural-language Question, and optionally an ErrorCode (e.g. '1205'). Returns a single result set; each row has a 'source' column ('incident' or 'runbook'), id, title, body, distance, and extra (JSON tags for incidents, NULL for runbooks). Rows are ordered by cosine distance — lower = more relevant.

LogTimeline.description: Returns the time-ordered log/event timeline for the given IncidentId. Use this when an agent needs raw timeline context for an active incident.

GenerateMitigation.description: Generates a proposed mitigation for the given IncidentId by running hybrid RAG search and calling the local chat-completion model. Pass DiagnosticsJson with the aggregated dx_* findings the agent collected before calling this tool — the model treats them as ground truth and reorders the runbook plan accordingly. Set WhatIf=true to build the prompt and call the model without persisting the result. Returns IncidentId, Status, ProposedMitigation.

DxIndexExists.description: Diagnostic dx_index_exists. Returns one row with finding ('index_present' | 'index_missing' | 'table_not_found') plus key_columns, is_unique, index_type. Call this BEFORE generate_mitigation when a runbook recommends creating a specific index, to check whether it has already been applied.

DxResourcePressure.description: Diagnostic dx_resource_pressure. Returns one row summarizing the last WindowMinutes of sys.dm_db_resource_stats. finding is 'pressure_high' (>80% CPU or log write), 'pressure_moderate' (50-80%), or 'pressure_normal' (<50%). Call this BEFORE generate_mitigation to gate any online DDL or large batched UPDATEs in the runbook plan.

DxDeadlockRecent.description: Diagnostic dx_deadlock_recent. Returns the most recent deadlock-shaped messages from the dbo.AppLog ledger. finding is 'deadlock_present' or 'no_deadlock_history'. Call this when the symptom is a deadlock (Msg 1205) or LCK_M_X wait, BEFORE generate_mitigation, to confirm the symptom is current.
